(the "Security Agent"), acting as trustee for itself and the Finance Parties, all of its present and future right, title, and interest in, to, and under (a) all bank accounts maintained with domestic and foreign credit institutions, (b) all material hotel management, franchise, and lease agreements relating to the hospitality assets operated under the "Aura Suites" brand, and (c) all intellectual property rights registered in any jurisdiction pertaining thereto, subject in each case to the Permitted Encumbrances and the revolving inventory baskets set out in Clause 14.2 (Asset Disposals); provided, however, that upon the occurrence of a clean-down period pursuant to Clause 18.5, the floating charge elements over perishable goods shall automatically release without prejudice to the fixed security created over the real estate assets under Clause 9.1.

Section 8.01. Events of Default. If any of the following events shall occur and be continuing, Apex Software Inc., acting as the Borrower, shall be deemed in default under this Agreement, and Apex Bank, N.A., in its capacity as the Administrative Agent, may, upon the written instruction of the Required Lenders, declare all outstanding Obligations immediately due and payable: (a) Non-Payment. The Borrower fails to pay any principal when due, or fails to pay any interest or fee within the applicable grace period expressly provided herein; provided, however, that any inadvertent administrative error shall not constitute an Event of Default so long as such payment is cured within the designated Business Day tolerance. (b) Cross-Default. Any default occurs under any material intellectual property licensing agreement or cloud infrastructure service contract of the Borrower or any Subsidiary, which default permits the counterparty thereto to terminate such agreement, resulting in a Material Adverse Effect. (c) Insolvency Proceedings. The Borrower or any Subsidiary institutes or has instituted against it any proceeding under any bankruptcy, reorganization, arrangement, readjustment of debt, dissolution or liquidation law of any jurisdiction, and such proceeding remains unstayed.

The obligation of Victoria Healthcare Group Limited to draw down the Revolving Facility is subject to the condition precedent that the Facility Agent shall have received, in form and substance satisfactory to it acting reasonably, all of the documents and evidence set out in Schedule 4 (Conditions Precedent), including without limitation: (a) certified copies of constitutional documents and board resolutions of each Obligor; (b) favourable legal opinions from counsel to the Finance Parties qualified under Hong Kong law; (c) evidence of full compliance with all applicable anti-money laundering and know-your-customer regulations; and (d) a solvency certificate executed by two directors of Victoria Healthcare Group Limited; provided, however, that if any non-material document specified in paragraph 3 of Schedule 4 is outstanding despite the Borrower using commercially reasonable efforts to procure the same, the Majority Lenders may, in their sole discretion, permit the Borrower to satisfy such condition within a period not exceeding 60 Business Days following the initial utilization date, failing which an immediate Mandatory Prepayment event shall occur under Clause 22.

{"clause_type": "conditions_precedent", "parties": ["Victoria Healthcare Group Limited", "Facility Agent", "Finance Parties", "Obligor", "Borrower", "Majority Lenders"], "obligation": "Victoria Healthcare Group Limited may not draw down the Revolving Facility unless the Facility Agent receives all specified conditions precedent documents or the Majority Lenders grant a deferral of up to 60 Business Days for non-material items.", "trigger_condition": "Prior to the drawdown of the Revolving Facility.", "financial_terms": ["60 Business Days"], "risk_flag": "medium", "risk_rationale": "Allows drawdown with outstanding documentation deferred for up to 60 Business Days, creating temporary unsecured exposure and potential default mechanics."}
